title: Event envelope
description: The envelope of every event Gotion publishes on Kafka. The AsyncAPI specification of each producer narrows type, version and data for each of its events.

eventId.description: The identifier of this event, which a consumer keeps to skip a repeated delivery.

type.description: The name of the event in the published language of its producer, in PascalCase.

version.description: The version of the schema of data; a change that is not compatible publishes a new version next to the old one.

aggregateId.description: The identity of the aggregate the event happened to, also the Kafka key of the event, so the events of one aggregate stay in order.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened, in UTC.

data.description: The body of the event: only identities and values, never an object of the producer's model.
